_comment: Nix build engine policy — consumed by aa_desk-usr_x86_surface-linux_nixos/build.sh. All tuning that governs how _rebuild_exec() behaves lives here, not hardcoded in the script.

phase1_scope._comment: systemd-run --user --scope properties applied to the nix build client (Phase 1). MemorySwapMax=0 = OOM-kill instead of disk-I/O thrash freeze. IOSchedulingClass=idle = block-layer idling that works on NVMe (IOWeight=10 is also set but has no effect on the 'none' NVMe scheduler — left as belt+suspenders for CFQ/BFQ fallback).

suspend_during_build._comment: User systemd services to stop before Phase 1 (nix build) and restart after, regardless of build outcome. These are background indexers/daemons that compete for I/O and CPU during builds. Only --user units should be listed here; system-level units are managed by the nix-daemon cgroup caps in configuration_system-protection.nix. Services not loaded/running are silently skipped — no errors.

services.reason: KDE file indexer — continuous inotify + I/O; competes directly with nix store writes
GNOME file tracker — same pattern as baloo; only present in GNOME sessions but harmless to attempt under Plasma
GNOME tracker metadata extractor — CPU-heavy during indexing bursts
